Only machines that use network boot are exposed, and the flaw, found by Anthropic and Google researchers, became public months ahead of a planned January disclosure after AMI published a code fix, leaving organizations to seek firmware updates from their vendors. Cathedral, a cybersecurity startup founded by former DOGE staffers, says its AI agents found ways into Anthropic’s internal systems in less than 12 hours by abusing weaknesses in third-party business software, reaching meeting transcripts, salary and job offer data, and Slack discussions about the company’s most advanced models, according to a draft report reviewed by the Washington Post (paywalled).
